phoneNumber.description: The phone number in the DNC list, in E.164 format.

source.description: The source or origin of the DNC entry.

addedDate.description: The date and time when the phone number was added to the DNC list.

addedBy.description: The user or system that added the phone number to the DNC list.

reason.description: The reason for adding the phone number to the DNC list, if provided.

lastModified.description: The date and time when the DNC entry was last modified.
